commandDeny.help: Restricts only MCP SSH command execution (execute) and task starts (job_start). Manual local terminals and interactive SSH terminals are not restricted. Rules are matched against the raw command; this is not a shell sandbox. Up to 32 rules per layer, 128 total, 512 UTF-8 bytes per pattern.
commandDeny.inherited: Inherited global rules are read-only here. Connection rules add restrictions and cannot cancel global rules. Interactive terminals are not restricted.
commandDeny.regexHelp: Uses the Rust regex engine (no look-around or backreferences). Syntax and matching are checked by the server, not JavaScript.
commandDeny.invalid: Invalid rules: IDs must be unique within a layer, 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, or _-.:. Patterns must be non-empty, without NUL, and at most 512 UTF-8 bytes. Limit: 32 per layer and 128 across the policy.
commandDeny.invalidServer: The server rejected the rule configuration. Check regex syntax and rule limits. Your draft is preserved.
commandDeny.previewHelp: Previews only MCP SSH command execution (execute) and task starts (job_start). Manual local terminals and interactive SSH terminals are not restricted. Manually checks the server matcher only; does not save, connect to SSH, or execute a command. The sample command is kept in memory only.
commandDeny.useDraft: Preview this draft instead of the saved policy
commandDeny.previewError: Could not preview. Check the configuration, including regex syntax, and try again. Your draft is preserved.
commandDeny.notMatched: No deny rules matched — this does not mean execution is allowed
commandDeny.draftResult: Draft result based on policy revision {{revision}}; not saved or effective.
commandDeny.blocked: Another host access restriction also blocks this operation.
commandDeny.notPermission: No match is not permission to execute. Enabled state, identity pins, operation grants, and other host restrictions still apply. Global rules cannot be overridden by connection rules.

hostAccess.futureProjectsHint: This includes projects added later. Turn it off to choose a fixed set below.
hostAccess.selectResultsHint: Select all adds only the current search results. Future projects are not automatically authorized.
hostAccess.noMatches: No matches. Try another search or clear the filter.
hostAccess.noProjects: No registered projects on this host.
hostAccess.grantToConfigure: Granting selects all 13 operations. Checked operations work on any path; you can switch to read-only or adjust individually. Changes apply after saving.
hostAccess.confirmAllWarning: All 13 operations include running any remote command, writing files, transfers and cancelling jobs, on any path. Applies to this connection only.
hostAccess.title: Host capability access
hostAccess.globalWarning: All MCP clients share ONE global authorization principal. These grants are not isolated per user or client. Access is off by default.
hostAccess.executeWarning: Granting a connection selects every operation. Checked means allowed: no extra root or job switch is needed. Use read-only or uncheck high-risk operations to narrow it; changes apply after saving.
hostAccess.remoteRoots: Remote roots (one absolute path per line)
hostAccess.localRoots: Se host local roots (one absolute path per line)
hostAccess.fingerprintChanged: This profile changed. Review the current target and explicitly reauthorize it before saving an enabled policy.
hostAccess.noProfiles: No SSH profiles configured. Configure credentials in SSH settings; no secrets are requested here.
hostAccess.readOnly: Host access management and active calls are disabled for public tunnels or forbidden access.
hostAccess.unauthorized: Authentication required. Reconnect with your remote access credential, then reload.
hostAccess.conflict: The policy changed elsewhere. Reload before saving; your draft has not overwritten it.
hostAccess.failed: Request failed. Check host access and granted operations, then retry.
hostAccess.cancelRequested: Cancellation requested. Refresh jobs to verify; remote termination is not guaranteed.
hostAccess.saveHint: Save before testing or refreshing jobs. Identity changes require explicit reauthorization. Saving preserves existing fingerprints and removes grants for deleted profiles; unchecking a profile revokes its grant.
hostAccess.pathLimitHint: Leave empty to allow any path. When filled, file operations and transfers only work inside these directories. Local roots refer to the Se host filesystem, not this browser. Roots do not constrain commands.
